title: Hosted Source Machine
statement: Given a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet, define a machine with twice as many work tapes as $M$, over the Boolean alphabet, and with states comprising tagged copies of the states used for the rewind, cleaning, and simulation phases. The machine is built by composing an emitted-return rewind phase, a cleaning simulation of $M$ initialized in its initial state, and a further rewind phase, with the indicated phase states and initial cleaning state.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
caveat: The supplied definitions do not explain the composition and emitted-return operations or the rewind machine, so their precise transition behavior cannot be rendered from this payload alone.
